newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy shares fall after revising forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy shares fall after revising forecasts.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp's shares fell in Wednesday morning trade after the firm revised downward its earnings forecast for the year to March 31, 1997, brokers said.
As of 0116 GMT, its shares were down 21 yen at 291, making it the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

On Tuesday, Japan Energy, which specialises in mining development and petroleum refining, said it now forecasts a net loss of 16 billion yen in its group earnings for the 1996/97 year, after a previous forecast of a 15.50 billion yen profit.
It also said its parent current profit was expected to fall to 1.00 billion yen, down from a precious forecast of 6.00 billion yen.
